replacements.Video-MME: la comprensión de vídeo no es: Video-MME: video understanding does not scale with duration
replacements.Los modelos que comprenden bien vídeos c: Models that understand short videos well fail on longer versions of the same tasks. Attention coherence degrades over time scales of minutes or hours.
replacements.coherencia alta · todo el vídeo en conte: high coherence · entire video in context
replacements.Toda la información cabe en el contexto: All information fits in the active context
replacements.El modelo puede atender a cualquier fram: The model can attend to any frame in the video with similar effectiveness. Questions that require linking the beginning and end of the clip remain manageable because the token distance is small.
replacements.Identificar el objeto que aparece primer: Identify the object that appears first
replacements.Verificar si algo cambia entre inicio y: Check whether something changes between beginning and end
replacements.El contexto no cubre todo el vídeo: The context does not cover the entire video
replacements.El modelo tiene que comprimir o descarta: The model has to compress or discard early frames to keep the video within context. Questions that link information from the beginning and end of the video fail because one of the references has been compressed or discarded.
replacements.Describir la segunda mitad del vídeo: Describe the second half of the video
replacements.Comparar algo del inicio con el final: Compare something from the beginning with the end
replacements.Contar cuántas veces aparece X a lo larg: Count how many times X appears throughout the video
replacements.Verificar si el estado inicial se mantuv: Check whether the initial state was preserved
replacements.caída de 40 pp respecto a vídeo corto ·: 40 pp drop versus short video · barely above chance level
replacements.La mayor parte del vídeo es inaccesible: Most of the video is inaccessible
replacements.El modelo solo tiene acceso coherente a: The model only has coherent access to the last few minutes of the video. Questions about earlier events are answered from prior assumptions or fabricated. The model does not know what it has lost: it produces answers with the same confidence as on short videos.
replacements.Identificar el personaje que aparece en: Identify the character who appears at minute 12
replacements.Verificar si una afirmación es consisten: Check whether a statement is consistent with the entire video
replacements.Describir la evolución de un tema a lo l: Describe how a topic evolves over the course of the hour
replacements.Los sistemas que analizan reuniones larg: Systems that analyze long meetings, films, or full conferences operate in this regime. Short-video benchmarks do not predict their real performance. A model scoring 78% on short clips can be close to chance level on hour-long videos.
